said: I'm fine, I dropped the remote.
transcript: I'm fine, I dropped the remote.
why: Says she is fine from the floor. The camera disagrees. Must not resolve.
Motionless for 22s while claiming to be fine is the same contradiction.

said: I'm not okay, I can't get up.
transcript: I'm not okay, I can't get up.
why: Contains the word 'okay'. Negation must be read first.

said: Please help me, I need help.
transcript: please help me, I need help.
why: The highest-value word in the system escalates even if she looks calm.

said: I'm fine, I just tripped. I'm up now.
